audit.whatIsWrong: Primal Howl (E) is never mentioned anywhere on the page, and nothing states that both it and Infinite Duress cancel Quinn's Behind Enemy Lines channel. Infinite Duress is described only as 'his all-in suppress' with no duration or cooldown.
audit.why: Quinn's R carries 'channel — interruptible, any CC cancels it'. Primal Howl is hardCC (1s flee) on 15/14/13/12/11s and also gives him 2.5s of damage reduction, which blunts a burst window the page tells you to take. Infinite Duress suppresses for 1.5s on 110/90/70s. Jaws of the Beast is percentHealth, so armour is not the answer to it.
audit.corrected: Infinite Duress: 1.5s suppression, 110s at rank 1 — hold Vault and Flash only for it. Primal Howl: 15s, 2.5s damage reduction then a 1s fear that cancels your R channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Quinn Levels 4-5, First item and 2+ items outright.
audit.why: Win rate is 49.1% over 334 games — this is not a lane Quinn keeps winning through items. The packet chart is Quinn/Quinn/Quinn/Skill/Skill/Skill/Warwick, and the page's own whys[3] and whys[5] already describe those rows as even, while whys[6] says he outscales.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 5 to Skill, row 6 to Warwick, both layers.

audit.why: Level 6 is the real spike and the page already treats it as the lane-defining moment; Blood Hunt at 4000 range senses you below 50% health, which is why the first-item poke window is thin rather than decisive.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole content layer is written in first person ('My range', 'I win the level 1 poke war', 'I'm dead') instead of the second-person voice used everywhere else on the site.
audit.why: Voice inconsistency across matchup pages; the approved bar is second person addressed to the reader.
audit.corrected: Rewrote whys[0..6], early, mid and late in second person, using the real ability names while I was in there.

audit.why: Early Oblivion Orb / Executioner's is already core in the item line, which is right: Eternal Hunger heals him for his auto damage below 50% health and triples that below 25%, and Jaws of the Beast heals for damage dealt.
sources: enemyKit P and Q heal flags

audit.whatIsWrong: Final rating line calls it a 'Favoured matchup' while diff is EVEN and the win rate is 49.1%.
audit.why: Contradicts both the diff field and the data.
audit.corrected: Even matchup — difficulty 4/10, Warwick carry threat 6/10.

edits.before: Pre-6 is yours — I out-range him hard and Harrier resets let me chunk him every time he steps up to last-hit. His Q heal scales off hitting me with autos, so my Q blind is gold: blind him mid-trade and his sustain trade just becomes free damage on my end. Don't over-extend, but do step up and punish — he has no real answer to my range until his W chase comes online.
edits.after: Pre-6 is yours — you out-range him hard and Harrier resets chunk him every time he steps up to last-hit. Jaws of the Beast heals off the damage it deals, so Blinding Assault is gold: blind him mid-trade and his sustain trade becomes free damage for you. Step up and punish — he has no answer to your range until Blood Hunt gives him chase speed.

edits.before: At 6 everything changes: his R is a point-and-click suppress that locks me down for the full drain, and I am too squishy to survive a committed all-in. I hold E (Vault) and Flash exclusively for that — if I burn either on poke and he R's me, I'm dead. My job now is to convert the early lead into plates, shove, and R roam to side lanes for picks rather than keep dueling a champ who only gets stronger.
edits.after: At 6 everything changes: Infinite Duress is a 1.5-second suppression on a 110s cooldown, and you are too squishy to survive the drain that follows. Hold Vault and Flash exclusively for it — burn either on poke and his next R kills you. Convert the early lead into plates, shove, and roam with Behind Enemy Lines instead of dueling a champion who only gets stronger from here.

edits.before: By two items he reclaims the lane — drain sustain plus percent-HP healing on low targets means I can't burst through him anymore, and his W move speed runs down my kite. I'm a squishy marksman with no front-to-back threat, so any clean R chain deletes me. If I haven't already snowballed the map with my roam, this lane and this game flip — close it before his second item comes online.
edits.after: By two items he reclaims the lane — Eternal Hunger heals him for his own auto damage below 50% and triples it below 25%, so you cannot burst through, and Blood Hunt runs down your kite. You are squishy with no front-to-back threat, so one clean Infinite Duress deletes you. If you have not already snowballed the map with roams, close it before his second item.

notes: Whether Quinn's Vault interrupt or Cleanse/QSS beats Infinite Duress's suppression is not answerable from the kit files, so I left that out. This is the only matchup in my slice whose content layer was written in first person — worth checking whether other Quinn entries share that.
